title: Dizzy audio issue when paired to BT speaker
body:
Dizzy demo will not play when paired to a BT speaker. The demo will play when the Audio track render has been removed or the BT speaker is disconnected. 

The Dash and SmoothStreaming examples playback without issue. 

Devices experiencing issues: 
Nexus 10 - 4.4.4
Nexus 5 - L
Speaker: Jawbone Jambox
